title: MVP waitlist landing page
requirements: Build a public landing page (route `/`) that describes Parade's purpose for single mothers in Ontario seeking co-parenting and co-habitation matches.
The landing page is the only public surface: it must allow registration (join the waitlist) and nothing else — no discovery, matching, messaging, or profile features are reachable.
Include a clear value proposition, how-it-works summary, and a prominent call-to-action to join the waitlist.
Be fully responsive and accessible (semantic landmarks, keyboard navigable, WCAG AA contrast).
Include SEO metadata (title, description, Open Graph/Twitter cards) and a shareable canonical URL.
Preserve the existing static-export build (`output: "export"`) and pass typecheck, lint, and build.
notes: Implemented as a new public `(marketing)` route group. The old protected home page at `(app)/page.tsx` was removed so `/` is now the public landing page; the `(app)` group remains for protected routes. Added `(marketing)/layout.tsx` (no app chrome) and `(marketing)/page.tsx` with full SEO metadata (title, description, canonical via `lib/site.ts`, Open Graph, Twitter summary_large_image). New components: `components/marketing/LandingHero.tsx` (value prop + primary CTA) and `components/marketing/HowItWorks.tsx` (3-step summary). Every CTA links to `/waitlist`; no protected routes are reachable. Added `lib/site.ts` (SITE_URL from NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL, canonicalUrl helper) and `lib/ontario-communities.ts` (canonical Ontario community list, shared with the waitlist task). Tests: `(marketing)/page.test.tsx` (4) and `lib/ontario-communities.test.ts` (10). Typecheck and tests pass. NOTE: `NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL` should be set in the deploy environment for the canonical/OG URLs to point at the production domain.
